A.policy: original full nine-DOF g+c+M*qdd pulse sequence
A.qualification_gate: original F .02 arm / .002 finger acceleration discrepancy; stop immediately at first failure

B.policy: same original full nine-DOF pulse sequence, diagnostic interior identity only
B.qualification_gate: F same thresholds, stop first failure; cannot qualify original .04

C.policy: tau_arm=Maa*a_arm+c_arm+g_arm; tau_f=g_f+20*(.04-q_f)-2*dq_f; full 9 commands; 120 hold, 28 signed arm pulses at .5 with q0 PD, 120 hold
C.qualification_gate: all R criteria plus original G1 and common safety; full K evaluated separately and never inferred from R

D.policy: 12 gravity+c steps, 8 alternating +/- .001 N*[finger1-finger2] constraint-normal force pulses; actual full nine effort commands
D.qualification_gate: K predicts response and original acceleration discrepancy thresholds apply to K prediction; free-model discrepancy expected and recorded as negative control

shared_initial_arm_and_object_source: unchanged QP6 Profile S05 sample(0), original q14 and object pose
mimic_equation: q_f2-q_f1+0=0; gearing=-1 and offset0 must be read from installed schema each run
constraint_prediction: M-weighted constrained acceleration QP, installed mimic ERP .9, unilateral semi-implicit position bounds; candidate model independently compared with actual response
stop_policy: any registered source gate failure latches; preserve failed pre/proposal/post; no further step or zero/last effort fallback. Independent source configurations may continue in fresh processes.
formal_eligibility: C original .04 reduced-model source checks must all pass AND D independently validates mimic normal-force mechanism AND all shared geometry/time/source requirements pass. B interior alone never qualifies. Full K label requires original .04 K prediction checks, not residual fitting.
